authorization: User authorized validate, promote, PR and merge if better or on par.
scope: Matched deployment-profile runtime upgrade, including release PCIe IPC, FP8 LM head, graph and kernel settings. Not single-variable image attribution.

high_context.claim: Report actual prompt tokens; do not claim full 393216 boundary.

quality_diagnostic.scope: Marker-based diagnostic, not executed coding benchmark; preserve raw failures. Independent semantic adjudication required for known brittle markers and any new mismatch.

turnover.claim: Bounded request turnover, not soak or p99 SLO proof

gates: All functional, thinking, multimodal and high-context exact assertions pass. No unexplained new diagnostic quality regression.
No OOM, CUDA error, Xid, NCCL WARN, process crash, automatic restart, parser corruption or unexplained request loss.
NCCL P2P and PCIe IPC initialization confirmed; no unexpected SHM fallback.

No repeatable greater than 5 percent regression in eligible matched median TTFT/E2E/decode at 4K and 120K. If any cell exceeds threshold, perform one bounded repeated matched A/B round before decision; no post-hoc threshold relaxation.
Same client model/context/output/modalities and final authenticated routed smoke/json pass.
Any serving_coverage warmup phase failed log is a hard failure even if health is ready. Both ranks must enable PCIe IPC all-reduce with world_size=2.

before_every_registry_write: verify inactive/dead and Job empty; abort otherwise
transaction.start: start once --no-block; poll every 2 seconds; allow up to 1800 seconds for fresh kernel compilation; stop on failed or auto-restart.
transaction.rollback: Guarded restore exact saved baseline recipe, recreate old container and verify direct and routed smoke/json before readmission. Never restart old patched container in place.
transaction.router: Keep quiesced throughout direct qualification. Readmit after gates, then routed checks; immediately quiesce and rollback on routed failure.

amendments.stage: baseline preflight failure, before candidate requests
amendments.observation: Baseline refused the synthetic launch-code needle twice at nominal128000; other9 functional checks passed. No authoritative runtime failure.
amendments.decision: Preserve failure; continue other baseline measurements to characterize current deployment. Candidate correctness criteria and 5 percent performance threshold unchanged. Do not classify baseline as fully passing.

amendments.stage: baseline characterization before any candidate requests
amendments.observation: All60 summary requests returned complete stop responses with their own marker and no foreign marker, but marker-at-start assertions failed. No unexplained response loss.
amendments.decision: Retain all raw failures. Use the already eligible exact32-word controlled prompt for the60-request turnover gate in both arms; keep strict canary and output-count assertions. No performance threshold change.
